title: Backdating Retention on FloodGuard Cancellation Credits
content:
FloodGuard Private Flood Policy — retention on backdated cancellations

A backdating retention keeps a share of the premium credit when the cancellation date precedes the date the cancellation request was received, as recorded on the request: 5 percent when it precedes it by more than 14 days; 2 percent when by at least one day but no more than 14 days; and nothing when the cancellation date is not earlier than the date the request was received.

The premium credit is the credit for the term premium together with any additional premium returned for limit increases. The retention is the percentage above taken of that premium credit; the rest of it stays in the credit.

**Input — judgement — output**

- *Input:* the cancellation date and the date the request was received, both as recorded on the cancellation request.
- *Judgement:* the number of calendar days by which the cancellation date precedes the date received.
- *Output:* more than 14 days, 5 percent retained; from 1 to 14 days, 2 percent retained; no days (same day, or a cancellation date after the date received), nothing retained.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical premium credit of 300.00)**

| Cancellation date relative to the date received | Retained | Remaining premium credit |
|---|---|---|
| 15 days earlier | 15.00 | 285.00 |
| 14 days earlier | 6.00 | 294.00 |
| 1 day earlier | 6.00 | 294.00 |
| Same day | nothing | 300.00 |
| 5 days later | nothing | 300.00 |
